authoredFrom: OTP 28 language reference + the pinned grammar's `maybe_expr`/`cond_match_expr` shapes (measured on real sites: otp/lib/stdlib/src/asn1ct.erl, otp/lib/stdlib/src/init.erl), before this fixture's F3 run. `maybe Exprs else Clauses end` is a fourth multi-way construct beside case/if/try; its `else` arms are `cr_clause` nodes and count as branches (base 1 + 2 = 3), and the construct itself adds none - the same rule case and try follow. `Pattern ?= Expr` is a match, so its left side is a PATTERN.

expectComplexity.note: base 1 + the two `else` arms; the maybe construct itself adds no point, exactly as case/try do

expectRelationships.note: a call inside a maybe body attributes to the enclosing function
a record field's type belongs to the record

forbidRelationships.note: a `?=` left side is a match
